## Block 4: Add K1023 to Core Experiments (Proposition Verification)

Add K1023 as a row in the "Core Experiments" or a new "Theoretical Verification" section:

```markdown
| K1023 | Proposition Verification — E[g]=1 Identity, VRP Auto-Correction, g tracks VRP | **Discussion Propositions 1-2 source**: SPY full sample 2005-2026 (n_analysis=4849). (1) Prop.1: Corr(τ_t, g_t)=0.493 [paper: ~0.49], Cov(τ,g)/E[σ²]=12.7% confirming identity E[σ²]=E[τ]E[g]+Cov(τ,g). (2) Prop.2: theta1_ratio_A4=0.781 [paper: 0.78], confirming MLE endogenously corrects for VRP discount. (3) Prop.3: σ²/VIX² ratio tracks VRP with Spearman ρ=0.819 (A3f, full period). | `experiments/k1023/` |
```

**Verification**:
- K1023 `proposition_1.A4_constrained.Corr_tau_g = 0.4930` → paper 0.49 ✓ (rtol=0.014)
- K1023 `proposition_2_vrp_auto_correction.theta1_ratio_A4 = 0.7808` → paper 0.78 ✓ (rtol=0.002)
